sources.observation: Homepage JSON-LD organization.logo points to Porsche-Romania-Logo-RGB.svg; site self-identifies as Porsche Finance Group Romania (Porsche Bank AG local subsidiary). Fetched 17782 B, original vector lockup (Signet group + wordmark paths).
About page states Porsche Finance Group Romania is the Romanian subsidiary of Porsche Bank AG; confirms record identity mapping. Site still uses 'Contact Porsche Bank' wording.
porschebank.com resolves to porschebank.at/international/ (Austrian parent group site), corroborating that the RO record is the Porsche Bank group brand, not Porsche AG.
